business_problem: Zhuiyin Technology had already built an agent for cross-border ecommerce analysis, but once the agent was exposed to customers, the team discovered three hard problems: results were hard to judge objectively, reasoning traces were opaque, and frequent data-source changes made it difficult to know whether model quality or tool behavior was improving or regressing. The business needed a scientific agent-operations loop rather than ad hoc debugging.
solution_summary: Zhuiyin Technology used Alibaba Cloud AgentLoop as the operating system for continuous agent evaluation and improvement around its Trekin Agent. AgentLoop captures full trace IDs, waterfall-style reasoning trajectories, and per-step input or output details so the team can see exactly where an agent selected the wrong tool, misunderstood intent, or mishandled a data source. On top of that observability layer, built-in evaluators measure task completion, tool-call success, and execution efficiency, while prompt-defined custom evaluators let Zhuiyin encode domain rules such as requiring a particular knowledge-base document. The team also uses trajectory decomposition plus curated good, bad, and corner-case datasets to regression-test changes before rollout. That turns agent quality into a monitored production metric rather than a subjective impression and lets the company reuse the same AI assets across cross-border commerce and other sectors.

solution_components.name: AgentLoop
solution_components.role: Provides the observability, evaluation, and continuous-improvement control plane for Trekin Agent.

solution_components.name: Trekin Agent
solution_components.role: Executes cross-border ecommerce analysis tasks such as reports, alerts, and sales diagnostics.

data_flow: Business questions are sent to Trekin Agent, whose multi-step reasoning and tool usage are captured by AgentLoop as traces and trajectory data. The resulting logs, evaluator scores, and curated good or bad cases are then used to refine prompts, tools, and retrieval behavior before updated agent behavior is rolled back into production.
business_outcome: Zhuiyin made agent quality observable and improvable instead of relying on intuition. After introducing AgentLoop, the company raised inference quality by 20%, reduced the need for manual rechecking of agent outputs, and built a repeatable evaluation asset base that can be reused as the business expands from cross-border ecommerce into logistics, trade services, and retail agent scenarios.
architecture_clues: Trace IDs and waterfall-style trajectories are treated as first-class production data for agent debugging.
The platform mixes built-in evaluators with prompt-defined custom evaluators so domain rules can be tested continuously.
Good cases, bad cases, and corner cases are stored as regression assets rather than informal examples.
Agent quality improvements are reused across multiple industry verticals instead of remaining specific to one customer workflow.
